verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI (Wally) that can run local models offline without an account, and it exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so scripted use is plausible. However, nothing documents a headless or CI mode. Cloud authentication is a browser approval flow, which works against unattended CI runs. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode, CI usage guidance or examples, a non-browser auth path (API key/token) for automation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so the official OpenAI clients work by pointing `base_url` at it.
